question: Find the volume of a sphere with a diameter of 30 cm. (π = 3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius of the sphere (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm.

Volume of a sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 3.14 × 15³

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 3.14 × 3375

⇒ Volume = 4 × 3.14 × 1125 = 14,130

**∴ The correct answer is 14,130 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the sphere (d) = 30 cm

Value of π ≈ 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2

Volume of a Sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 3.14 × (15)³

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 3.14 × 3375

⇒ Volume = 4 × 3.14 × (3375 ÷ 3)

⇒ Volume = 4 × 3.14 × 1125

⇒ Volume = 4500 × 3.14

⇒ Volume = 14130 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 14,130 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total area covered by the outer surface of a complete 3D sphere. Formula: Area = 4 × π × r².

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a complete sphere. Formula: Volume = 2/3 × π × r³.

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

It includes both the curved outer surface area and the flat circular base area. Formula: TSA = 3 × π × r².
